text_block_list.text:
With an astounding show of talent, Air
Groove
wins the Hanshin Juvenile Fillies.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
However, she states that it's merely a
waypoint
on her journey to reach her
ideal.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Эйр Грув wishes to become a shining
beacon
that all Umamusume aspire
toward.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
In order to achieve that, she firmly
announces
that she will be running in the
Tiara tour: the Oka
Sho, the Japanese
Oaks, and the Shuka Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
